binding.equality_rule: Projection equality is necessary equality evidence only. Never use it as a bearer credential, authentication, generation freshness or proof that no replacement occurred. Retain exact source observations separately in authenticated original state; digest collisions or aliases cannot upgrade equality to continuity.
binding.continuity_rule: If namespace/mount/process/task/group/descriptor continuity is not independently proved in the same authenticated generation, fail PROOF_UNRESOLVED before effects. A new spelling, digest, PID, timestamp, container name or hidden generation counter cannot fill the proof gap.
binding.snapshot_limit: No claim that sequential proc/stat reads are atomic. Future coherent observation/lifetime proof remains unimplemented and unaudited.

namespaces.canonical: Exact built-in str, ASCII, lowercase kind, literal colon and square brackets, canonical unsigned decimal. Reject whitespace, signs, leading-zero aliases, alternate case, escape spellings and non-ASCII; no normalization. JSON uses the frozen canonical encoder.
namespaces.active_pid_namespace: Use /proc/<pid>/ns/pid, not pid_for_children. Numeric IDs are interpreted in the fixed observer procfs PID-numbering view; a target's namespace inode alone does not define observer numbering.
namespaces.width_limit: No Linux semantic inode digit maximum is established by historical source or frozen platform requirements. 256 is an accepted wire ceiling only. Reject unrepresentable observations without truncation or silent hashing.

namespace_identity.preimage: ASCII domain + one NUL byte + canonical JSON bytes of the fixed seven-element list [user,mnt,net,pid,ipc,cgroup,uts] containing the exact validated raw strings. ensure_ascii=true, sort_keys=true, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=false, ASCII encoding, no newline. No outer generation or dictionary keys are added to this preimage; they remain independently authenticated bindings.
namespace_identity.collision_rule: SHA256 collision resistance is a projection assumption, not proof of authentication or unique kernel incarnation. Raw components are retained and compared where exact equality is required.
namespace_identity.decision: Raw tuple-as-string would embed JSON quoting and conflate the aggregate equality key with human-readable individual observations; ad hoc concatenation is rejected. Digest chosen for this aggregate equality role with frozen preimage, not to meet the cap.

cgroup_identity.preimage: ASCII domain + one NUL byte + exact raw-byte length encoded as unsigned 8-byte big-endian + the complete exact raw bytes. No decode/re-encode, strip, trim, line-ending conversion, line sorting, path normalization, parsed normalization or automatic final newline. Reject incomplete/oversized reads before a complete claim. Length >=2^64 is unrepresentable and fails unresolved.
cgroup_identity.raw_width: No semantic listing byte maximum is pinned; the length-prefix acceptance ceiling is 2^64-1, not a kernel bound or an observer input budget. A future observer must prove a complete bounded read under existing timeout/byte/record limits.
cgroup_identity.source_limit: Historical open(...).read() preserves text at Python's text layer; it does not prove byte-exact acquisition or a cgroup object-incarnation identity. This explicit raw-byte digest rule is new declarative semantics only.
cgroup_identity.decision: Direct raw text can contain multiple lines and arbitrary path bytes, with no established 256-byte semantic bound. Parsing/normalizing would erase distinctions. Digest chosen because consumers compare complete membership observations; raw bytes remain authenticated retained evidence, not protocol-exported content. No HMAC substitution or budget-driven digest choice.

start_facts.parser_requirement: Stat field 22 is a numbered Linux format field. comm can contain spaces and parentheses; naive whitespace split of the whole stat line or first ')' delimiter is insufficient. Process/task fact collection must prove correct parsing and coherent binding; no parser or live read is implemented here.
start_facts.counter_limit: No architecture clock width, tick frequency, wrap semantics, boot-ID encoding or PID reuse interval is pinned. Do not infer 19 digits from the numeric schema: start_identity is an id string, not a uint field.

numeric_metadata.semantic_source: Full int(st_mode), including file type, special and permission bits; never stat.S_IMODE. Check file type against kind, reject special files and links. Root must be directory. Metadata is not object identity.
numeric_metadata.representation: Exact built-in int; ordinary canonical JSON decimal. No bool, float, sign on nonnegative values, leading zeros, exponent, octal, quotes or coercion.
numeric_metadata.range_basis: Existing uint/positive_int schema admission; not a claimed native Linux kernel type width.
numeric_metadata.mode_width_basis: Allowed Linux regular-file/directory full type bits require at least five decimal digits; schema-only upper envelope remains 19. No permissions-only alternative.
